patchdist_score — SPC anomaly_patch op

• 数据种类:image2d × table → table

• 调用: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.patchdist_score(image, model, smooth=4.0)(要直接调用实现,import anomaly_patch; anomaly_patch.patchdist_score(image, model, smooth=4.0);从台账取用则 opsspc.get("patchdist_score"))

• GPU:无(仅 CPU 参考实现)

用法

将一张图像与逐位置的正态分布比较:由各图块的马氏距离生成异常图(table)。

> 以下的详细说明为原文 —— 摘要与标题已翻译。

model comes from patchdist_fit; image must have the training images' shape. The grid of distances sqrt((x - mu)' P (x - mu)) is interpolated (bilinear, between patch centres) to the image size and smoothed by a Gaussian of smooth px (0 = no smoothing). Returns map (H, W; higher = more anomalous), grid (the raw distances), image_score (the maximum of the smoothed map) and smooth.

Raises ValueError for a model that is not a patchdist_fit result, a different image shape, or a negative / non-finite smooth.
